title: A Well for the Winter
author: Freya Thornbury
blurb: Astrid Sterling, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
